Secure Update Channel

The key protects the update path. The export boundary protects the engine.

1

Local Build

Private engine builds full receipts and command centers locally.

2

Redaction Gate

Only approved static HTML, JSON and images move to export.

3

Signed Export

Public SHA-256 manifest can prove which display bundle was published.

4

SSH Deploy

Repo-scoped key updates GitHub Pages without exposing private engine files.

private_receipt_hash: stored-locally-not-published
